title: NIH State of the Science Conference Statement on Manifestations and Management of Chronic Insomnia in Adults
doc_summary:
Here are 6-10 concise bullet points on recommendations and behavior-change measures for managing chronic insomnia:
* Establish a consistent sleep schedule and bedtime routine
* Create a sleep-conducive environment, such as keeping the bedroom cool, dark, and quiet
* Avoid stimulating activities and electronics before bedtime
* Avoid caffeine, nicotine, and alcohol close to bedtime
* Try relaxation techniques, such as deep breathing, progressive muscle relaxation, or meditation, to help with sleep
* Consider cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) to address underlying sleep issues
* Limit naps and avoid napping close to bedtime
* Get regular exercise, but not too close to bedtime
* Avoid heavy meals close to bedtime and try to finish eating at least 2-3 hours before bedtime
* Keep a sleep diary to track sleep patterns and identify potential issues
